job.theme: a monsoon trek in the Western Ghats
job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: Dear Rohan, I am finally back from our school trek to the Western Ghats. We started our journey on 12th July, reaching the base of Kalsubai peak just as the clouds descended. My friend Arjun was leading the group, while our teacher, Mr. Deshmukh, kept checking the map. The trek was exhausting because the heavy rain made the rocky path extremely slippery. We had to walk slowly to avoid falling. At one point, we saw 45 colorful butterflies resting on a wet leaf, which was a magical sight. Mr. Deshmukh told us that the slippery path is a result of the monsoon rain. By the time we reached the summit, my legs felt like lead, which is just a way of saying I was very tired. I am glad we finished the trek safely before the evening fog set in. It was an experience I will never forget.
response.summary: A student describes a challenging monsoon trek in the Western Ghats with friends and a teacher. They faced slippery paths due to rain but enjoyed seeing nature before reaching the summit.
